prospect.occupation: Account and project manager at a SaaS company, fully remote with a flexible schedule and international customers. His employer acquired a Polish image-recognition technology company, Shelfwise, and much of his team is Polish.

Trains almost every day, minimum twenty minutes, and describes rest days as something he is bad at. Has a well-equipped gym on the first floor of his building plus a 20lb kettlebell in the apartment. Uses sauna and cold plunge.
prospect.medical: Recurring sharp pain on the outside of the left hip that radiates to the top of the left foot, intermittent and worse without rest days, cause unknown and self-hypothesised as possibly a blood-flow issue. Restricted shoulder range of motion. Reduced forearm and grip strength relative to his climbing history. No other conditions disclosed and none were asked about — no bloodwork, medications or diagnoses were discussed at any point.
